Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|S_{013710012}|^p) \leq C_013710012\) follows from the subharmonic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. Consider the complex operator \(S_{013710013}\) acting on the affine variety. By the complex decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{013710013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_013710013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the holomorphic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_013710011 \cdot C_013710012 \cdot C_013710013\).
